name: Coherence
description: How well the response follows the context and is logically connected to the previous message

name: Relevance
description: How relevant the response is to the topic or question being discussed

name: Fluency
description: How natural and smooth the language used in the response is

name: Engagement
description: How engaging and interesting the response is, including the use of questions, anecdotes, or other interactive elements

name: Semantic Similarity
description: How similar the response is in meaning to the context and previous messages

name: Novelty
description: How unique and original the response is, including the introduction of new information or perspectives

name: Diversity
description: How diverse the response is in terms of vocabulary, syntax, and ideas
